steps.cmd: mkdir -p /labs/ws/src && cp -r /labs/lesson11/examples/drive_interfaces /labs/lesson11/examples/drive_demo /labs/ws/src/
colcon build
source install/setup.bash && ros2 interface show drive_interfaces/action/DriveDistance
source install/setup.bash && ros2 run drive_demo drive_server
ros2 action list -t
ros2 action info /drive_distance
source install/setup.bash && ros2 action send_goal /drive_distance drive_interfaces/action/DriveDistance "{distance: 1.0, speed: 0.5}"
source install/setup.bash && ros2 action send_goal --feedback /drive_distance drive_interfaces/action/DriveDistance "{distance: 0.3, speed: 0.5}"
steps.why: The first feedback can be printed before or after the line saying the goal was accepted; lesson11.test.ts checks the feedback values.

steps.cmd: source install/setup.bash && ros2 action send_goal /drive_distance drive_interfaces/action/DriveDistance "{distance: -1.0, speed: 0.5}"
source install/setup.bash && ros2 run drive_demo drive_client 3.0 0.5
source install/setup.bash && ros2 action send_goal /drive_distance drive_interfaces/action/DriveDistance "{distance: 1.0, speed: 1.0}"
sleep 5
source install/setup.bash && ros2 run drive_demo drive_client 3.0 1.0 1.0 2>&1 | grep -v 'to go'
ros2 topic list --include-hidden-topics | grep drive_distance && ros2 service list --include-hidden-services | grep drive_distance
mkdir -p /labs/ws/src
python3 /labs/lesson11/check.py
cp -r /labs/lesson11/solution/charger_interfaces /labs/lesson11/solution/charger /labs/ws/src/
colcon build
source install/setup.bash && (ros2 run charger charger > /dev/null 2>&1 &) && sleep 2 && python3 /labs/lesson11/goal_client.py 0.3
python3 /labs/lesson11/check.py
